title: Configure Deployment HPA Autoscaling
prompt:
Workload `api` in namespace `cka-hpa` runs with static scaling and must automatically scale based on CPU utilization.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Create a `HorizontalPodAutoscaler` named `api-hpa` in namespace `cka-hpa` targeting Deployment `api`.
2. Configure `api-hpa` with minimum replicas `2`, maximum replicas `5`, and target average CPU utilization `70%`.
hints: Ensure container resource CPU requests exist on `api` (already configured) before creating the HPA.
Use `kubectl -n cka-hpa autoscale deployment api --cpu-percent=70 --min=2 --max=5` or apply an `autoscaling/v2` YAML.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: cka-hpa
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 32Mi

checks.description: Deployment `api` has at least 2 ready replicas

manifests:
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: api-hpa
  namespace: cka-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: api
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 5
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70

reference_solution: Create HorizontalPodAutoscaler `api-hpa` targeting Deployment `api` with minReplicas 2, maxReplicas 5, and CPU utilization 70%.
